title: tidy_scan
description: RESERVED for Phase 6B (T6.13) — shape from tidy-prd.md §7 tidy_scan, FR-1, FR-2, FR-9; not routed yet. CEP WNC_TIDY.scan (signed bridge). Read only: walk the project tree (items and bins), usage per sequence (clips of video + audio tracks) and up to 3 graphic Source Texts per sequence.

data.description: No data (the PRD's host function takes no argument).

nodeId.description: project item nodeId (bins are found by nodeId, never by path: tidy-prd.md §8)

path.description: media path (a sequence has none): its type is not stated in the PRD, left open

offline.description: Premiere's flag (FR-3: unreliable, the engine checks the file)

color.description: label colour: its type is not stated in the PRD, left open

duration.description: duration: its type is not stated in the PRD, left open

items.description: {nodeId,name,bin,isSequence,path,offline,color,duration}. The object stays open: the PRD lists these keys, keys the host adds are not rejected.

nodeId.description: project item nodeId (bins are found by nodeId, never by path: tidy-prd.md §8)

items.description: {nodeId,path,name}. The object stays open: the PRD lists these keys, keys the host adds are not rejected.

usage.description: {seqNodeId: [nodeIds]}: project items referenced by each sequence's clips

texts.description: {seqNodeId: [raw Source Text]} (FR-2, top video track first, at most 3)

project.description: the project: its type is not stated in the PRD, left open

readback.description: {items,bins,usage,texts,project,name}. The object stays open: the PRD lists these keys, keys the host adds are not rejected.
